headlines.title: Tracking Hurricane Isaias as it moves across the southern U.S.
headlines.description: Isaias made landfall on the Florida Panhandle Friday evening, bringing heavy rains and strong winds and is now moving inland. It is the first hurricane of the Atlantic season.

headlines.title: Hurricane Isaias makes landfall in Florida
headlines.description: Hurricane Isaias made landfall near Destin, Florida, around 8:30 p.m. local time as a Category 2 storm with 105-mph winds. NBC News’ Bill Karins explains what’s next as the storm continues to move.

headlines.title: 'Take this serious': Florida Lt. Gov Jay Collins warns residents to brace for Hurricane Isaias
headlines.description: Florida Lt. Gov Jay Collins is warning residents to brace for Hurricane Isaias as it gets ready to pass through the state, saying to stay safe and off of the roads as first responders work.

headlines.title: 'Hopefully we have a home to go back to': Florida resident evacuates ahead of Hurricane Isaias landfall
headlines.description: Gloria Centanni is a new Florida resident and homeowner who evacuated with her husband, who just had surgery, and her seven-month-old baby. NBC News' Brian Cheung speaks to Centanni about how they evacuated and her recently-bought home that is in the storm's path.

headlines.title: Alabama makes final preparations for Hurricane Isaias before landfall
headlines.description: NBC News' Brian Cheung talks to Deputy Director of Montgomery Emergency Management Laura Goudreau about the final preparations the state is making ahead of Hurricane Isaias making landfall.

headlines.title: 'The weather had other plans': Couple postpones wedding because of Hurricane Isaias
headlines.description: Blake and Barbara White had to postpone their wedding and the events leading up to it that they had planned near Destin, Florida, because of Hurricane Isaias. NBC News' Brian Cheung speaks to the couple on when they found out and the journey back home.

headlines.title: Hurricane Isaias pounding Gulf Coast
headlines.description: Isaias is pounding the Florida Panhandle and conditions are rapidly deteriorating as the storm’s powerful eye moves on shore. NBC News’ Jesse Kirsch reports.

headlines.title: Special Report: Hurricane Isaias downgraded to category two as it's expected to make landfall
headlines.description: Hurricane Isaias has downgraded to a category two as it is headed to make landfall, but dangerous conditions are still expected. NBC News correspondents are covering when the hurricane is expected to move onshore and how to stay safe.

headlines.title: Conditions intensify in Pensacola as Hurricane Isaias begins to move onshore
headlines.description: NBC News' Tom Llamas talks to Telemundo's Karol Suarez Aponte about the dangerous conditions in Pensacola, Florida.

headlines.title: Heavy rain batters Florida as Hurricane Isaias approaches landfall
headlines.description: Heavy rain and strong winds batter parts of Florida as Category 3 Hurricane Isaias approaches the continental United States. WJHG reporter Delaney Smith reports from on the ground in Walton County, Florida.

headlines.title: Trump: Russia will send diesel fuel to the U.S. to bring down prices
headlines.description: President Trump said he spoke to Vladimir Putin and Russia will send hundreds of thousands of barrels of diesel fuel to the U.S. aimed at bringing down prices at the pump. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: Food pantries overwhelmed by Trump cuts
headlines.description: Those on the front lines of feeding their neighbors in rural West Virginia say they face unprecedented challenges brought on by Washington.
